description: Decode a JSON Web Token (JWT) and analyse its claims. Always returns header, payload, signature info, and expiry status (active/expired/not_yet_valid) computed from exp/nbf/iat. When `secret` is provided, verifies HS256/HS384/HS512 via HMAC. When `public_key` is provided in PEM format, verifies RS256/RS384/RS512 via openssl_verify. ES* and EdDSA are decoded but not verified. The token is never logged.

public_key.description: PEM-format RSA public key for RS256/384/512 verification. Optional.

secret.description: Shared secret for HS256/384/512 verification. Optional.

token.description: Full JWT (three base64url segments joined with dots). "Bearer " prefix is stripped automatically.

name: jwt_decode
